item.title: Research Consultant I
item.description:
The Utah State Developmental Center (USDC) is a state-operated intermediate care facility providing services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). The Research Consultant I is responsible for accurately documenting, analyzing, and reporting data collection trends within USDC, ensuring compliance with applicable federal and/or state laws, regulations, and standards. The position requires a wide range of knowledge pertaining to the rules and regulations of an intermediate care facility. Note: a background check is required. The position is in-person/on-site in American Fork, Utah. Application deadline: August 16, 2026. 1 year of experience working with individuals with IDD is required.

Key responsibilities include: performing studies and analysis of significant and critical issues of concern to USDC; developing recommendations based on project findings and providing detailed plans and analyses; facilitating the use of research data to improve existing programs; designing, developing, and conducting a variety of research projects including determining appropriate methodologies, information sources, sampling strategies, and data-collection tools; ensuring compliance with applicable federal and/or state laws, regulations, and standards; collaborating with staff to investigate incidents, gathering facts and context to support appropriate action; tracking follow-up actions including corrective measures, outcomes, and resolution status; assisting in preparing for audits or inspections related to critical incident reporting; communicating with treatment teams to ensure timely and appropriate interventions; and reporting trends and patterns of incidents to management with recommendations for improvements to policies or procedures.

Qualifications: 1 year of experience working with individuals with IDD (required); intermediate level experience using Microsoft Office and Google Suite; professional research or data analysis experience preferred. The position is a first-level research consulting role in which incumbents perform independent study and analysis of significant and critical issues.

Compensation and logistics: salary 5.22-2.22/hr (2,458-7,818 annualized). Comprehensive Utah state benefits. In-person/on-site at 895 N 900 E, American Fork, Utah 84003. Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm. Application deadline: August 16, 2026 (may close earlier if sufficient applicants are received). Background check required.
